title: An intrusive list
description:
Write `LIST_ENTRY` lists and `CONTAINING_RECORD` in user mode.

```
insert tail: 1 2 3
insert head: 0
walk: 0 1 2 3
remove 2: 0 1 3
each entry found its record through CONTAINING_RECORD
```
hints: Insert tail: `e->Flink = head; e->Blink = head->Blink; head->Blink->Flink = e; head->Blink = e;`.
requirements: `struct ListEntry { ListEntry* Flink; ListEntry* Blink; };` with a head that points to itself when empty.
`struct Item { int value; ListEntry link; };` and a `containingRecord` that gets the `Item*` from a `ListEntry*` with `offsetof`.
stretch: Protect the list with a spin lock model and show what goes wrong without it.
